# SetWriter.ExistingSet

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Output` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public record SetWriter.ExistingSet
```

What a Set already on disk contributes to an extend run.

## Constructors

### ExistingSet(IReadOnlyList&lt;string&gt;, int, string?, SetModels?) { #m-ctor-system-collections-generic-ireadonlylist-system-s-d2e3ce }

```csharp
public ExistingSet(IReadOnlyList<string> Dnas, int NextNumber, string? CookbookSha256 = null, SetModels? Models = null);
```

**Parameters**

- `Dnas` (`IReadOnlyList<string>`) - Every DNA already minted, so new rolls can avoid them.
- `NextNumber` (`int`) - The number the next asset should take.
- `CookbookSha256` (`string?`) - What `set.json` recorded as the source archive's hash, so an extend can tell whether the CookBook it was handed is the one that cooked this Set — see [`SetProvenance`](Nfty.Core.Output.SetProvenance.md). **Null means "cannot tell"**, never "they differ": the Set may have been cooked from an in-memory book, or from a build before the field existed, and its `set.json` may be absent or unreadable. Optional so it is additive at every existing call site.
- `Models` (`SetModels?`) - What `set.json` recorded about the Set's 3D models, or null when it recorded none (cooked without models, or unreadable). Optional so it is additive.
